paragraphs.text: Wherever the racers go, help follows.
To keep up with the Grand Prix, reporters trained just as hard as the racers themselves.
Some seek thrills in watching the show. Some seek thrills in being the show.
Cloudspire's might comes from its unparalleled coordination.
"These gators are driving like idiots!" —Redshift
"Just a few more bolts—SHARK ON YOUR RIGHT—and we should be good to go."
The ghost shrieked as Terrin's blade sank deep. Perhaps a second death would teach it not to mess with his dog.
"Declarative: A unit is only as strong as its network."
To the Guidelight Voyagers, a vehicle is just another hardware upgrade.
The Quickbeasts' diet of aether makes them capable of astonishing maneuvers.
"No one dies under my watch." —Sektem, Lotusguard veteran
Their race ended much the same way it began, walking through a sandstorm on a world that ended long ago.
No road has to be traveled alone.
"The Guidelight Voyagers seem to exhibit more humanity than their flesh-and-blood competitors." —Pia Nalaar

"We follow as it walks at the head of the ever-breaking day. Is it leading the dawn, or does it march to some forgotten celestial order? It does not answer our questions, so faith must sustain us." —Chakshi, Dawnchaser pilgrim
"For most people? The odds would be insurmountable," Daretti said. "But we're not most people," Pia replied.
"To victory . . . eventually!"
"Exclamatory: Hang on to something."
The Guidelight Voyagers had been stranded on Avishkar with no way to get home. They considered every last unit essential, down to the glitchiest grunt.
Control lost is adventure gained. —Keelhauler proverb
For centuries, she grew in her benthic home, safe from Muraganda's moonfalls, feeding on the raw leylines that run below the water. When she emerged, the coral depths she called home came with her.
"Declarative: Goodbye."
There had been a time when the Endriders would've killed for water.
The biggest collector of vehicles on Avishkar is also the largest.
"Analysis: Systems operating at 125% efficiency. Stress within expected tolerances. Exclamatory: Punch it."
"It takes a thick skin to ride among the Keelhaulers."
"The secret to good piratin' is being ready for anything. That, and havin' eight arms."
For the Guidelight Voyagers, there is no such thing as junk.
"Is someone asleep at the wheel, or are the wheels driving themselves?!" —Vnwxt, Grand Prix host
The Aether Rangers repurposed thopters once used for Consulate surveillance so they could scout the track.
By the end of the race, few of the Aether Rangers' vehicles resembled what they started as.
"In cases of extreme emergency, just wing it." —Rocketeer safety manual, full text
"Oi, you ain't gonna believe what these kelpheads just threw away!"
Garima was delighted to finally test out her design. The amazing views were a bonus.
"So many fears. Let's make them all come true."
The druid's aim was dead on. But their choice of target was dead wrong.
"Target acquired. Resolution: Imminent impact."
"We are now accepting over eleven different interplanar currencies, including polished moonfall!"
Every camera had a backup, and every backup had a backup, and every backup's backup had a backup, too.
"This looks like a winning vehicle. But you lot ain't a winning team."
"Remember: You can take the wheel if you want, but *I* choose the music."
"That net was made to hold skywhales. Good luck getting to the next checkpoint!"
"Make peace with your end, for not even your legacy will remain." —Zahur
At the Tombs Before Time, the living of Amonkhet made vital alliances with the honored dead.
The Speedbrood doesn't differentiate between salvage and carrion.
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth." —Zahur
Amonkhet champions become markedly more reckless after dying.
In a land of undeath, permanent pest control solutions are few and far between.
Gastal's vampires took fuel from the dead.
Win or lose, she will sate her hunger.
Kheti lost everything to the Eternals and the Phyrexians. What she gained was an intimate knowledge of death in its myriad forms.
Might makes right-of-way.
"This is still a negotiation. We haven't broken anything... yet." —Far Fortune
Galadak's Scar is full of craters which are home to terrifying predators of immense size and savagery. Yet even among such company, Kalakscion—and her insatiable hunger—eclipses them all.
The rearview mirror showed Winter what awaited him should he fail.
"Captain, the cowards are throwing *bugs* at us!" —Sphyr, Keelhauler lookout
Compared to the Fuel Wars on Gastal, this Grand Prix is a thrilling vacation.
"And you're telling me this was designed for *children*?" —Sita Varma
By the time Shantanu heard the Endriders chanting "The claw!" he was already in its grasp.
In life, she commanded the respect of her army. In death, she demands it.
"Don't think of it as cheating, think of it as track they forgot to lay out for us." —Rido, Endrider
It yields only to the gods themselves.
Caution is for those who falter.
"Good sportsmanship wins the crowd. Bad sportsmanship wins the race." —Winter
"They feed on OIL? Where were they during the Phyrexian Invasion?!" —Chandra Nalaar
After years of hunger, the oil-thirsting vampires of Gastal finally had their fill.
Some horrors are created. Others are the recognition of a possibility that has always existed.
"Lot of folks on Duskmourn are more scared of dying than what comes after. Oh, how wrong they are." —Winter
"Either I win or we both lose. Take your pick."
"With your help, Loot, we're going to make a hell of an entrance," said Chandra. In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.
Redshift told his team to destroy the competition. They were thrilled to discover he meant it literally.
"Launch the explosives! No, you idiot, not like that!" —Redshift, Rocketeer chief
Endrider magic was developed on a world that was constantly on the move—the higher the velocity, the stronger the magic.
"Our world died, but we survived. Funny how it's the opposite for you." —Rido, Endrider
"Consider me an accident no longer waiting to happen."
Killswitch finally had the right wrench for the job. Now she needed to remember what the job was.
"No, it's not quite as simple as 'point and boom,' but if you must summarize." —Daretti
"What a bunch of junk. I'll take the lot."
In lieu of brakes, the Rocketeers installed a second accelerator pedal.
"Don't you know it's dangerous to go faster than us?"
Repairs are tomorrow's problems.
Endriders learned the rules of the road on Gastal, which meant they didn't learn any rules at all.
Under moonfall conditions, there's nothing you can do but drive and hope for the best.
"Fire the cannon, mates, fire it quick! The sea's full of chum and we want our pick!" —Keelhauler shanty

The Avishkari delegation considered their treaties with the Saurid Autocracy settled, but that was a crucial misunderstanding. To the Autocracy, diplomacy is a matter of power, not paper; testing the Grand Prix's defenses is merely their way of making a counteroffer.
"She knows what I'm thinking before I do. That is what true partnership means."
Exercise kindness, for nothing remains small forever. —Alacrian proverb
An early lead puts a target on your back.
Lagorin would not lose another.
The Brood aspires to become speed itself.
"Anyone running low?"
Though the Fang Druids desired peace, the Grand Prix's interference threatened to awaken old dangers on Muraganda.
"It's aggravating that nature can build better hazards than I ever could." —Termin, track designer
"Roadkill" takes on an entirely different meaning when the beast you crash into is more likely to kill *you*.
The Speedbrood regards molting as a selfless act worthy of the highest of honors. It allows one to be born anew for the good of the brood.
As it digested the demonic roadster, it too learned the thrill of speed.
Like most goblins, Rocketeers value nothing more than a good old-fashioned near-death experience.
"Someone please call pest control. Again." —Termin, track designer

Initially frustrated by Muraganda's inconsistent biodiversity, Avishkari researchers made a breakthrough after mapping the plane's aetheric index—the wide variety of fauna was the result of raw magic, not evolution.
All creatures great and small contribute to the stampede.
The Fang Druids call it the World Tyrant, for it has consumed entire ecosystems that it keeps suspended in its core. To look upon it is to see the world as it was eons ago.
"Don't avoid the wreck. Survive it." —Far Fortune
"A new day dawns for Avishkar, and we shall draw our power from its light."
"Let's show 'em how the Keelhaulers say hello!"
The only honor greater than piloting a Speedbrood vehicle is becoming one yourself.
For Team Cloudspire, the track is merely a suggestion.
Many brought weapons to the race. This crew built theirs as they went.
It was easy for them to replace lost crew members once they reached home turf.
"Stay in formation! We win this together, or not at all."
Oil-actuated inventions raised eyebrows after the Invasion, but no one could argue against the efficacy of the design.
A mighty memorial to a fallen savior.
"Your enemies will underestimate you, but you must never underestimate yourself."
"Observation: At current rate of travel, eventual rediscovery of home is a mathematical inevitability. Firm imperative: Let's go."
The Sting Strike model saved thousands of lives during the Invasion and quickly became a bestseller for Shadowblayde Craftworks.
Vnwxt's contract demanded at least one dedicated camera on him at all times.
From the screaming of Duskmourn's possessed metal came the happy cries of freed souls.
Ten teams. Ten dreams. One winner.
"ADMIT ONE. ENJOY THE RACE."
The warrior rose in a very different world from the one he'd left behind.
"Don't get too cocky. We're all junk to the cleanup crew." —Far Fortune
Stage 2: The sands and waters of Amonkhet.
Stage 1: The winding streets of Ghirapur.
"Despite being older than nearly every living thing here, Loot is still just a kid. That doesn't change what we need from him." —Jace
To the Endriders, racing is worship. Their prayers rise on the howls of straining engines. Explosions punctuate their chorus of shouts, forming a hymn of glory to the open road and all roads to come.
The Alacrian Quickbeasts desire not only to win, but to forge new alliances against the unknown threats of this interconnected Multiverse.
The doomed souls of the Speed Demons race in uneasy unity, each one hoping to escape their own fate.
When asked, the Speedbrood never put their motives into words; they simply say that velocity is their way of life. Only by becoming speed itself can one truly understand their reason for racing.
Stage 3: The steaming jungles of Muraganda under falling skies.
The Indigo Revolution changed more about Avishkar than just its name. Even Gonti's infamous night markets had gone legitimate.
"While Loot's ability to predict Omenpaths is extraordinary, I'm more impressed by his unrelenting curiosity." —Pia Nalaar
The Goblin Rocketeers want nothing more than to push the limits of kinetic energy and see if their machines can go the farthest, fastest, first.
For the Champions of Amonkhet, the stakes go beyond victory. They race to show the Multiverse that their home is not a dead plane to be mourned, but a living world just beginning to awaken.
"Loot is free to go where he wants, so let's make sure the kid gets there in one piece." —Chandra Nalaar
The Keelhaulers channel their prey drive into thrilling, cutthroat pursuits. Glory is all the sweeter when it's won at the expense of others.
The Indigo Revolution ousted the Consulate once and for all. Now the citizens of Avishkar cheer for the Aether Rangers as they try to bring victory and glory to their new nation.
The Guidelight Voyagers seek only a means to return home, hoping to one day discover a way back among the many worlds they race across.
"I'm worried about Loot. He has great power but lacks the experience to know what dangers await him." —Vraska
"If nothing else, that Loot is one brave little rat." —Winter
Team Cloudspire burns with the pride and passion typical of competitors on Kylem. As the reigning champions of the Ghirapur Grand Prix, they have no intention of losing their title.
When the worst happens, rely on the best.
Get the shot. Every time.
Captivate the competition.
Hard light. Hard attitude.
This car is what dreams are made of.
Don't buy the rest. Possess the best!
Take it for a spin. That's not a request.
Style that never runs on fumes.
Take flight on the wings of true innovation.
Go where only death dares follow.
Leave a nightmare in your wake.
Seize the day . . . and anything else that happens to catch your eye.
A ride worth dying for. Or in.
Cut through the air like a corsair!
It practically drives itself!
Go everywhere. See everything.
Don't let the end of days stand in your way.
Take a bite out of life.
The road is where you take it.
Vintage is back, and it's hunting you.
A car you'd sell your soul for.
Thopters conditionally included.
Choose your own destiny.
Some say they want to see the world. We say why stop at just one?
It'll satisfy your need for steed!
"Suck my seaweed!"
License plate: G4S BR34TH.
"Gentlegoblins, start your dragons!"
The one and only velocity raptor.
"I'm the wretch who can fletch!"
"Party on the poop deck!"
"The fauna here functions as a planar antibody." —Rashmi, aether-seer
"It's the dawn of a new era, and we shall rise like the suns to greet it."
The first four crashes were accidental. Then the Endriders joined the fun.
The Invasion roused the reclusive jalpari from the depths. Since then, they had fully integrated into Avishkari society.
The search for her lost mentor continued.
"Here's a tip: If your ride needs souls for fuel, make sure to always keep one handy."
Jace knew that if he just had time to explain his plan, he would find support. Unfortunately, time was in short supply.
"Racers! Start! Your! Engiiiiiines!"
Summoning it is easy. Controlling it is another matter.
Speedbrood racers are gregarious while not racing, but everyone must eat.
"You wanted a fight. Now you've got two." —Chandra Nalaar
Speedbump has miraculously survived ninety-nine rocket crashes, and he's aiming for an even hundred.
Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.
Let the past die so the future might live.
Many of the inventions built to fight the Phyrexians have since been repurposed for civilian use.
Loss is not the end of the journey.
After devastation, hope bloomed.
Get carried away.
Get things rolling ... and never stop.
"This baby runs on unleaded O negative."
"You've got the dream machine. I've got the nightmare mach-ightmare."
"Anybody looking for a torque dork?"
